```{r}
seurat_list <- c(
  seurat_list_1,
  seurat_list_2,
  seurat_list_3,
  seurat_list_4
)
# Kiểm tra
length(seurat_list)
names(seurat_list)
```

```{r}
for(i in seq_along(seurat_list)){

  prefix <- unique(seurat_list[[i]]$sample_id)

  seurat_list[[i]] <- RenameCells(
    seurat_list[[i]],
    add.cell.id = prefix
  )
}
```

```{r}
head(Cells(seurat_list[[20]]))
```

```{r}

```

###==== Integration ==== # 

```{r} 
rm(list = ls())
gc()
```

```{r}
combined <- readRDS("../results/RDS/combined.rds")
```

```{r}
# Preprocessing
combined <- NormalizeData(combined)
combined <- FindVariableFeatures(combined)
combined <- ScaleData(combined)
combined <- RunPCA(combined, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
```
```{r}
gc()
```

```{r}
options(repr.plot.width = 8, repr.plot.height = 8)
p <- ElbowPlot(combined, ndims = 30)
p
```

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 23.5 * 1024^3)

# RPCA Integration
combined <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = combined,
  method = RPCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:20,
  reference = 1,
  new.reduction = "integrated.rpca",
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
## Recommended
# Reference-based Integration
# Here, we use the first layer as a reference for integraion
# Thus, we only identify anchors between the reference and the rest of the datasets,
# saving computational resources
#  reference = 1

# Modifying parameters
# We can also specify parameters such as `k.anchor` to increase the strength of
# integration

#  k.anchor = 20
```


```{r}
DefaultAssay(combined)
Assays(combined)
Reductions(combined)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

# re-join layers after integration
combined[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(combined[["RNA"]])

combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:20)
combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = 1)
combined <- RunUMAP(combined, dims = 1:20, reduction = "integrated.rpca")
```

```{r}
options(repr.plot.width = 13, repr.plot.height = 10)
DimPlot(combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sample")
options(repr.plot.width = 11, repr.plot.height = 10)
DimPlot(combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters")
```

```{r}
combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = 0.5)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(combined, file = "../results/RDS/integrated_obj.rds")
```
